title: Little & Khalsa 2005 lumbar facet capsule capsule strength

quantity.name: capsule strength
quantity.definition: abstract-reported strength (peak stress; body text reports no damage up to 50% strain - definition not detailed)

source.n: 35 facet capsules from 8 lumbar spines (ramp tests: 25 parallel = 5 per level L1-L2..L5-S1, 10 perpendicular; dynamic subset 15 parallel)
source.sample: human lumbar facet joint capsule (L1-L2 to L5-S1), isolated capsule with bony attachments (parallel) or glued to acrylic plates (perpendicular)

protocol.summary: Uniaxial tension of isolated capsule in PBS bath (pH 7.4, room temperature); preload 0.1 N defines resting length; preconditioning 6 cycles to 50% strain at 15%/s with 300 s holds; ramp-hold trials to 10, 20, 30, 40, 50% grip strain at 15%/s held 300 s (rate 1-15%/s had no effect on modulus); first principal strain by optical image correlation; parallel specimens 6.08+-2.58 mm long, 11.59+-2.87 mm wide, 1.88+-0.94 mm thick; perpendicular 6.83+-1.45 x 7.11+-2.45 x 2.51+-1.66 mm. Tangent modulus = slope of linear portion of engineering stress vs first principal strain; viscous (peak) and elastic (after 300 s) moduli = secant from (0,0).
how_to_simulate: Model a capsule strip (approx. 6 mm long, 11.6 mm wide, 1.9 mm thick) loaded parallel or perpendicular to the medial-lateral collagen direction
Precondition, then ramp to 10-50% grip strain at 15%/s (hold 300 s for elastic values)
Report engineering stress vs first principal strain in the central region; compute tangent / secant moduli as defined

extraction.check_notes: Stiffness and Poisson's ratio from Results text (mean+-SD); strength, extensibility and dynamic moduli from abstract (no SD). Rows mix orientations - compare per row. doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
